messages.subject: Right Tunnelling | Mining, geotechnical infrastructure and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Right Tunnelling Leadership Team,

Right Tunnelling stands out within this Thailand search because your business directly spans tunnelling, mining development, geological work and complex civil engineering. That creates a close fit with my current operating background.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy for a major gold-mining operation.

I bring direct familiarity with mining regulators, environmental agencies, communities, technical teams and the governance needed around high-risk industrial work. I also support energy-transition and carbon-data initiatives within the mine environment.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG, Strategic Partnerships or country/project stakeholder leadership. I have attached a Right Tunnelling-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
